_rules: Builder may only change a feature's 'passes' value, and only after opening its evidence file. Never add, delete, or reword features.

features.description: A visitor opens the home page and sees one line saying what the site does, a search box (ZIP, City, ST, or state), a 'Use my location' button, a state list, and a short 'Before you go' note
steps: Run start.ps1 and open http://localhost:8095 at 375px wide
Verify the search box and 'Use my location' are on the first screen with nothing competing
Verify the state list links to /state/{st}/ pages and 'Before you go' mentions proof of service and calling ahead

features.description: A veteran enters ZIP 46052 and sees real nearby locations sorted by distance, one card per location, with name, offer(s), dates and time window, street address, miles, tap-to-call phone, Google and Apple directions links, and an 'Offer details' link
steps: Open the home page and search 46052
Verify results load from /near/ and are sorted nearest first
Verify a location with several offers shows them stacked on one card
Verify each card has every field listed, and 'Show more' appears past 50 cards

features.description: Every place shown is real and belongs to the right brand: locations come only from the data pipeline (All The Places filtered by country and brand:wikidata, or hand-entered single locations with a source), every offer links to its source, and data/coverage.md and data/missing-brands.md exist
steps: Open data/coverage.md and verify locations per brand, low-count flags, and test-ZIP counts are listed
Spot-check 10 random locations: brand Q-id matches, state and coordinates are in the US or a US territory
Search 10001 and open three 'Offer details' links; verify each goes to the offer's source_url
Verify brands with no location data show a 'Find nearest' maps link instead of invented stores

features.description: Every results page has an 'Everywhere' section for offers with no store (like National Parks), and single-location offers within 150 miles appear with their distance
steps: Search 46052 and verify the Everywhere section lists offers with no store
Search 23185 (Williamsburg, VA) and verify Colonial Williamsburg and Yorktown appear with miles

features.description: A veteran can change the radius (10/25/50/100 miles, default 25); when fewer than 10 places are found, the radius widens 25 to 50 to 100 automatically and the page says 'Showing up to 100 miles because few places are close by.'
steps: Search 46052 and switch the radius between 10, 25, 50 and 100; verify the count changes
Search 59301 (Miles City, MT) and verify the auto-widen message and results

features.description: All 13 test ZIPs in reference/SPEC.md section 7 (including 00901 San Juan, 96910 Hagatna and 00802 St. Thomas) return locations or a clear Everywhere section with a note; none errors or shows a blank page
steps: Search each of the 13 test ZIPs in turn
Verify each shows results or an explained Everywhere section
Save one screenshot that shows the territory results

features.description: The visitor's ZIP, city and coordinates never leave the browser: no request contains them, all distance math runs on the page, no cookies, no third-party scripts
steps: Record the network log while searching 46052, 'Lebanon, IN', and a mocked location
Verify only static files from the same origin are requested (ZIP shard and tile files by index only)
Verify no cookies are set and no request URL or body contains the ZIP, city or coordinates

features.description: Every page footer shows the Veterans Crisis Line ('Call 988, press 1 · Text 838255'), a not-affiliated-with-any-listed-business notice, and links to About; the About page explains sources, last-checked date and privacy in plain words
steps: Open the home, results, state, print and About pages
Verify the footer text on each
Verify About lists sources, the last-checked date and the privacy statement

features.description: The production build in dist/ is deploy-ready for Cloudflare Pages: _headers and _redirects are in place, file count and sizes are under Pages limits (build fails if not), and DEPLOY.md gives J.Will exact steps to deploy, add a custom domain, turn on Web Analytics, and rebuild daily
steps: Run the documented build command and verify dist/ is produced
Verify the build reports file count under 20,000 and every file under 25 MiB
Verify /near/46052 works when dist/ is served as plain static files
Open DEPLOY.md and verify the steps and the one-line daily rebuild command

features.description: Every page type is accessible: axe shows zero violations, the whole search works by keyboard, it works at 200% zoom, body text is at least 18px, tap targets at least 48px, in both light and dark themes
steps: Run axe on home, results, state, offer, print and About pages in light and dark
Tab through a full search with the keyboard only
Check results at 200% zoom and at 375px wide

features.description: Offer timing follows the visitor's own time zone: 'Starts Tue, Nov 10' before the start, a highlighted 'Today' during, 'Ended' and moved to the bottom after the end, 'Voucher good until ...' when there is a redeem-by date, and a time-window chip parsed into data/overrides.json (never guessed)
steps: With the clock set to Nov 9, 11 and 12 and Dec 1, in New York and Hawaii time zones, search 46052
Verify the labels and ordering for each date
Verify Denny's shows a '5 a.m.–noon' chip and Texas Roadhouse shows its voucher date

features.description: A veteran can search by 'City, ST' (e.g. 'Lebanon, IN', 'San Juan, PR', 'Fairbanks, AK') or a state name, or tap 'Use my location' (asked only on tap) and get the same kind of results
steps: Search 'Lebanon, IN', 'San Juan, PR' and 'Fairbanks, AK'
Search 'Indiana' and verify it goes to the state page
Tap 'Use my location' with a mocked location and verify results

features.description: A post volunteer opens /print/?zip=46052&r=25 and gets a large-print list: 16pt or larger, one column, no images, with name, offer, address, phone and distance
steps: Open /print/?zip=46052&r=25
Emulate print media and verify the layout
Verify a 'Print' link is on the results page

features.description: With JavaScript turned off, the home page state list leads to 56 pre-rendered /state/{st}/ pages (50 states, DC, PR, GU, VI, AS, MP) showing national offers, that state's offers, and top cities
steps: Disable JavaScript and open the home page
Open /state/in/, /state/gu/ and /state/tx/ and verify the content
Verify 56 state pages exist in dist/

features.description: A veteran can filter results by category (meals, coffee & treats, shopping, haircuts & car care, attractions), free only, and who qualifies (veteran, active duty, Guard/Reserve, retiree, spouse or family, Gold Star), using eligibility tags from data/eligibility-map.json
steps: Search 46052 and apply each category filter
Turn on 'Free only' and verify discounts disappear
Pick 'Gold Star' and verify only matching offers remain
Open data/eligibility-map.json and verify every offer has at least one tag

features.description: Search links can be shared: /near/46052 and /near/?city=lebanon&st=IN both reopen the same search, and the last search is remembered so a reload works on a bad connection
steps: Open /near/46052 directly and verify results
Open /near/?city=lebanon&st=IN directly and verify results
Search, reload the page, and verify the search comes back

features.description: Errors show a plain message and a way forward: unknown ZIP, denied location permission, offline, and a failed tile load
steps: Search 00000 and verify the message
Deny the location prompt and verify the message
Go offline and block one tile file; verify the message and that the rest still works

features.description: The site is fast on old phones: home page under 60 KB transferred (gzipped), results usable within 3 seconds on Slow 4G, Lighthouse mobile 95+ for performance and accessibility, works in Safari 14 and Chrome 90
steps: Measure home page transfer size
Throttle to Slow 4G and time a 46052 search
Run Lighthouse mobile on home and results
Smoke-test a search in Playwright WebKit

features.description: Each offer has a pre-rendered /offer/{slug}/ page with details, terms, who qualifies, source and a 'find the nearest' search; the site has sitemap.xml, robots.txt, Open Graph tags and a text-only OG image
steps: Open /offer/texas-roadhouse/ and /offer/national-parks/
Verify an offer page exists for every offer in dist/
Open sitemap.xml and robots.txt; check OG tags on the home page

features.description: The site is named 'Vet Day Deals' everywhere a visitor or search engine sees it: page titles, header, footer, About, print page, Open Graph tags, the share image og.png, sitemap.xml and canonical links. SITE_URL is https://vetdaydeals.pages.dev and DEPLOY.md uses project name vetdaydeals. The words 'VetsEatFree' / 'Vets Eat Free' appear nowhere in dist/. The app folder, repo and data files keep their names.
steps: Open the home, results, state, offer, print and About pages and verify the name 'Vet Day Deals'
Search dist/ for 'VetsEatFree', 'Vets Eat Free' and 'vetseatfree' and verify zero matches
Open dist/sitemap.xml and the home page's canonical and og:url tags and verify https://vetdaydeals.pages.dev
Open DEPLOY.md and verify every deploy command uses --project-name vetdaydeals and Way B (Wrangler) is the main path, with a note that dashboard drag-and-drop is limited to 1,000 files

features.description: Every page except the home page has a clear 'New search' button at the top (at least 48px tall, plain words, works by keyboard and with a screen reader) that takes the visitor back to the home page search box. On the results page it sits above the results and also appears again at the bottom after 'Show more'. Pages: results (/near/), offer pages, state pages, print page (hidden when printed), About and the 404 page. It always goes to the search page, not the browser's history, so it works when the link was opened from Facebook, a text or a share.
steps: Search 46052, then tap 'New search' at the top and verify the home page search box is shown and focused
Scroll to the bottom of the 46052 results and verify the second 'New search' button works
Open /near/46052 directly in a fresh tab (no history) and verify 'New search' still goes to the search page
Verify the button on an offer page, a state page, the print page, About and the 404 page; verify it doesn't appear when the print page is printed
Tab to it with the keyboard and check its height is at least 48px at 375px wide

features.description: Stores that the chain's own store page shows as temporarily closed, coming soon, or gone are not listed. Scope: only the ~600 source records run 1's round-9 sweep flagged (mostly Wendy's, plus Chipotle, Charleys, Pilot/Flying J and Great Clips; recover the list from commits fff5812 and 2aab420). Re-check just those pages politely (cached, rate-limited, respecting robots.txt) and add each confirmed one to data/location-exclusions.json with reason, source_url and date. No sweep of other chains.
steps: Open data/location-exclusions.json and verify the new entries each have a reason, an https source_url and a date
Spot-check 10 new exclusions: open each source page and confirm it says closed, coming soon, or is gone
Search the ZIPs of 5 excluded Wendy's and verify they no longer appear, while open Wendy's nearby still do
Verify data/coverage.md and the store count are updated

features.description: Counts read correctly everywhere: '1 store location' / '0 store locations' on state pages, '1 place' on the print page, and the same singular/plural rule on results
steps: Open /state/vi/ and /state/as/ and verify the wording
Open /print/?zip=00802&r=100 and verify '1 place' or 'N places' as fits
Grep the templates for other count labels and verify each uses the rule

features.description: The print page widens the radius the same way the results page does when few places are close (opening /print/?zip=00802&r=25 directly shows the widened list and says so), and its 'Back to results' link is at least 48px tall
steps: Open /print/?zip=00802&r=25 and /print/?zip=96910&r=25 directly and verify the widened list and message
Measure the Back to results link height

features.description: Every standalone link and button is at least 48px tall; links inside sentences meet WCAG 2.2 target-size rules (inline links are allowed smaller). Covers About, offer pages, the 404 page and the DC state page's duplicate 'Washington' links (show it once)
steps: Run the tap-target check on every page type at 375px
Open /state/dc/ and verify 'Washington' appears once in top cities

features.description: Small messages read right: 'Find the nearest' never shows an empty chain list (Hy-Vee from 46052 says plainly that the nearest is over 100 miles or in which states it has stores); /near/abc shows the unknown-search message instead of reopening the last search; source links to roundups (military.com, VA News, legion.org) say 'Opens the offer list where we found this' instead of 'Opens the business's page'
steps: Open /offer/hy-vee/ and use Find the nearest from 46052
Open /near/abc directly
Open an offer sourced from military.com and one from a brand's own site and compare the link wording

features.description: The share image og.png shows its whole text, with the new name 'Vet Day Deals' (nothing cut off at the edges), and still contains no logos
steps: Open dist/og.png and verify every word fits inside the image with margin
